                                           NOTICE
         It is hereby informed to all concerned that an Annual Extempore Speech Competition,
  organized by the Department of Political Science, North Gauhati College, in commemoration
  of Swahid Kanaklata Barua, will be held as per the schedule given below.

         All the teachers and students are requested to attend the programme and extend their
  cooperation in making it a success.

         The Heads of the concerned Departments are requested to kindly send at least three
  participants from each Department to participate in the competition.




      Programme Details
     Date: 23 September 2026 (Wednesday)
     Time: 12:30 PM
     Venue: Seminar Room, North Gauhati College




                                                                 Dr. Bhaskar Jyoti Hazarika
                                                                         Principal
                                                                   North Gauhati College
